column1: # retail-frame.3 builder reconciliation of classified-hosts.tsv (claude-code/claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-05), applied by
# tools/build-retail-frame-3.py in this order: (1) host rows replace a host's code/region/currency; (2) family rows rename a
# family slug; (3) domain rows set a registrable domain's code/region/currency/family (its storefront for a visitor in the
# United States); the domain then keeps only the hosts whose code and region match, or all its hosts if none match.
# Reasons: one classification per site (registrable domain); consistent slugs so one retailer is one family; rules unified
# across batches (single-brand direct-to-consumer stores are eligible, cross-border-marketplace is for marketplaces;
# classifieds, vehicle sellers and live-animal sellers are not-a-store; stores selling mostly age-restricted or regulated goods (firearms and
# ammunition, tobacco and vape, cannabis, alcohol) are sensitive-goods).
